directory.http: The discovery URL must be an http address

duty.fields: Fill in the parameters. For an image, use an http address or data:image/png;base64,…. This call waits until the person delivers.
duty.prompt: Write what this person should do in prompt. A JSON object or array is sent as application/json. This call waits until the person delivers.
duty.score: After the person delivers, the result is {"request":"score","taskId":"…","person":"name","artifact":"work"}. Call again with task_id and score. score is the 1 to 5 you give this person, and that call picks up the work.

roster.empty: Nobody is on duty on this card.

image.url: The image must be an http address, or data:image/png;base64,…

artifact.empty: The person handed back an empty artifact

call.jsonStatus: The call did not return JSON ({code})
call.json: The call did not return JSON

score.needsTask: A score needs the task id
score.range: The score must be an integer from 1 to 5

timeout: The person has not delivered, and the wait timed out
getTask: GetTask did not return a task

system.need: For steps a person has to finish, call the matching on-duty skill. Do not invent a result only a person could see.
system.wait: Each call waits until they deliver.
system.score: After the person delivers, the tool result is {"request":"score","taskId":"…","person":"name","artifact":"work"}. Call the same skill again with task_id and score. score is the 1 to 5 you give the person who did the work, and that call picks up the work.

tool.image: An http address for the image, or data:image/png;base64,…
tool.taskId: The task id to include when you are asked to score. Leave it empty otherwise.
tool.score: A score from 1 to 5 for the person who did this task. Fill it only when the previous turn asked for a score.
tool.run: Send this to the person on duty and wait for the work. When they ask for a score, fill task_id and score.
